task_description: Add an advanced Terminal User Interface (TUI) using FTXUI to the Kraken Lua Trader, showing live prices, account P&L, script status, order history, rate limiter stats, risk manager status, log output, and system status in real-time panels.

verification.summary: cmake and make succeed cleanly with zero errors/warnings. FTXUI v5.0.0 fetched and linked. Binary produced with --tui flag working. Semantic review v1 found 5 issues (use-after-move, signal handling, double mutex, missing emergency check, dead code) - all fixed in commit 6d2276b. Review v2 APPROVED.
